StagedInviteeEmail.name: StagedInviteeEmail
StagedInviteeEmail.description: Represents an email address that is included on a calendar event but that doesn’t match an existing user, contact, or lead record.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the record owner.

StagedInviteeEmail.accessRules: This object is available with Einstein Activity Capture when Sync Email as Salesforce Activity is turned on.
